account_id.description: The agent's NOVA account ID, e.g. agent1.nova-sdk-7.testnet. Must match the host-injected API key.

group_id.description: Target NOVA group. The account must already be a member; store_file does not join.

content.description: The full file content to encrypt and upload (UTF-8 text).

sha256.description: 64 lowercase hex chars: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of content, computed by the caller. Verified before any network call.
